sources.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen2.5-1.5B with LoRA - GitHub
sources.snippet: Companion repo: Interpreting-LoRA-Fine-Tuning uses this same training setup and analyses what the LoRA update actually changes inside the model (update norms, effective rank, representation drift). Instruction-tuning a large language model with LoRA. Starting from the base Qwen2.5-1.5B, I train lightweight LoRA adapters (PEFT) on the Alpaca dataset so the model learns to follow instructions ...
